items.prompt:
Read.

The water cycle is how water moves around Earth.

The topic is:
A) the water cycle
B) oceans only
C) clouds only

steps: Whole text topic. Key is A.

items.prompt:
The sentence that introduces the topic is the:
A) conclusion
B) topic sentence
C) caption

steps: Introduces the topic. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which belongs in an informative text?
A) facts and definitions
B) made-up adventures
C) only opinions

Read.

Sharks are fish. They have lived for millions of years.

Which is a supporting FACT?
A) Sharks are the best
B) They have lived for millions of years
C) I love sharks
items.answer: B) They have lived for millions of years

steps: A true detail. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) They have lived for millions of years

items.prompt:
In informative writing, related facts should be:
A) grouped into paragraphs
B) scattered randomly
C) left out

A sentence that explains what a word MEANS is a:
A) definition
B) conclusion
C) title

steps: Explains a word. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which is the BEST topic sentence for a report on the heart?
A) The heart is a muscle that pumps blood through the body.
B) I had a check-up once.
C) It was a long day.
items.answer: A) The heart is a muscle that pumps blood through the body.

solution.answer: A) The heart is a muscle that pumps blood through the body.

items.prompt:
Read.

Bats help the environment. They eat insects, and they pollinate plants. In short, bats are important to nature.

Which sentence is the CONCLUSION?
A) Bats help the environment.
B) They eat insects.
C) In short, bats are important to nature.
items.answer: C) In short, bats are important to nature.

steps: Sums up the text. Key is C.
solution.answer: C) In short, bats are important to nature.
